answer: Each epoch issues a fresh set of required words, and duplicate or near-duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger by hash, so one generated text cannot be replayed across 4 accounts. A farm must therefore produce 4 genuinely different texts, and its reused karst of copies collapses to a single submission. The quartz of effort per account rises sharply, and the meadow payoff of a copy-paste strategy drops to zero.
